title: Goodnight, Little Garden
character: Dot, a small round red ladybug with seven black spots, a shiny shell and a friendly face.
palette: leaf green, rose, buttercup yellow, sky blue, soft brown.
sky: golden afternoon → peach dusk → lavender evening.
cover: Dot on the tip of a big leaf in a garden full of flowers.
style: Children's picture-book illustration for ages 3 to 6 in painted-paper collage: every shape is a piece of hand-painted textured paper with visible brush marks and torn or cut edges, layered on a cream paper background, a limited palette of five muted colours plus cream, no outlines, no gradients, no photorealism. Backgrounds are mostly plain cream paper with a few large simple shapes. Dark colours only in small pieces, never large dark areas. Warm, calm, sleepy mood. No text, letters or numbers anywhere in the image.

pages.text: The garden is warm and gold. Dot the ladybug climbs to the very top of a leaf.
pages.beat: Dot on a leaf tip, flowers behind, golden light.

pages.text: The bumblebee drops into a flower, buzzing slower and slower. Goodnight, little friend.
pages.beat: Round fuzzy bumblebee inside a big pink flower, Dot on a nearby leaf.

pages.text: The garden spider finishes her web, sits in the middle and folds her legs. She is gentle, and very proud of her web.
pages.beat: Friendly smiling orb-weaver spider in a neat round web with dew, Dot watching.

pages.text: The snail slides home under the mint leaves, carrying his house on his back.
pages.beat: Snail with a spiral shell under leaves, Dot beside him.

pages.text: The ants march in a line back into their hill, the very last one carrying a crumb.
pages.beat: Line of ants entering an anthill, Dot on a stone.

pages.text: The caterpillar curls up on a cabbage leaf, full and sleepy.
pages.beat: Striped caterpillar curled on a big leaf, Dot nearby.

pages.text: The dragonfly lands on the pond reed and rests her four wings.
pages.beat: Dragonfly on a reed over a small pond, Dot on a lily pad.

pages.text: The grasshopper does one last hop, then sits still in the grass.
pages.beat: Green grasshopper in tall grass, peach sky, Dot on a blade.

pages.text: The butterfly folds her wings under a rose petal.
pages.beat: Butterfly with closed wings under a rose, Dot on the stem.

pages.text: The earthworm wriggles down into the cool soft soil. Goodnight, little friend.
pages.beat: Cross-section of soft brown soil with a smiling worm, grass on top and Dot alone on a blade of grass, only one ladybug.

pages.text: Dew drops settle on the web, on the leaves, on Dot.
pages.beat: Close-up of Dot with round dew drops on leaves, lavender sky.

pages.text: Dot tucks her wings under her shell and sleeps on her leaf. Goodnight, little garden.
pages.beat: Dot asleep on her leaf, the quiet garden around her, first stars.
